description:
[read-only] What the reviewer said through a review link, draft by draft: `decision` (approve, changes or deny), their comment and name. `contentId` is the draft (get_content). Needs a connection with the write scope. `id` from list_campaign_shares.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/campaign-shares/{id}.)
name: get_campaign_share_verdicts
title: Read a review link's verdicts
